title: Mod Checker - Plugin
description: The Mod Checker - Plugin is the plugin part of mod checker that receives the mods signal that checks your mods and flags.
body:
Stop cheaters before they even set foot in your server. Mod Checker - Plugin is a high-performance client-server verification tool designed to provide total transparency over who is joining your server. By auditing player environments during the initial connection phase, it ensures that only authorized mods make it past the loading screen.

Core Features
Real-Time Mod Auditing
The moment a player connects, the tool performs a deep-scan handshake that logs their entire mod list. No more guessing what "client-side" cheats someone might be hiding.

Custom Blacklist Engine
Complete control via a simple configuration file. Define exactly which mod signatures or client types are "illegal" for your server. If a player matches the list, they are flagged immediately.

Instant Admin Enforcement
When a prohibited client is detected, admins receive a real-time notification containing the player’s details and a one-message ban system. Neutralize threats instantly.

**This plugin is an original work. If there are anyforks I don't know about LET ME KNOW!**
